places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena lives above the Dry Bean saloon, cooking at first and then taking customers; Augustus offers her money just to talk.
places.location_hint: south Texas, north bank of the Rio Grande, flat chaparral; Mexico visible across the river

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Visible from Lorena's window at the Dry Bean.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Lippy says Lorena could get rich working there, but she finds it no more appealing than Texas.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena's dream destination because it sounds cool; Augustus claims to have been and describes the bay at length.

places.name: Mobile
places.note: Lorena's family left it when she was twelve, fearing the Yankees.

places.name: Baton Rouge
places.note: Lorena's mother died there, leaving her stranded until Mosby Marlin found her.

places.name: Gladewater
places.note: Mosby kept Lorena in a bare, mosquito-ridden house near it and began selling her; Tinkersley took her away.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Lorena spent two miserable years in east Texas; she judges Texan men harshly.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Tinkersley kept Lorena in a hotel there and had her see his gambling companions until his luck soured.

places.name: Matamoros
places.note: Tinkersley and Lorena set out by stage for it; he abandoned her in Lonesome Dove along the way.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Augustus jokes they could live there just as cheaply as in this heat.

groups.label: Lorena
groups.hint: in Lorena's room above the Dry Bean saloon, heading down to play cards
